mines.mine_notes: FY2025: 70,120 oz gold poured (69,774 oz sold) at AISC A$2,561/oz (AUD; no USD conversion applied as the report gives no FY2025 average FX rate). Milled 1,083,858t at 2.31 g/t head grade, 85.45% recovery. Underground ore mined 1,160,986t @ 2.22 g/t. Avg realised price A$3,770/oz. Mining on four deposits (Wyoming One, Caloma One, Caloma Two, Roswell); primary ore source Roswell. Flotation and fine grind circuit commissioned Dec 2024; paste plant Jan 2025. Open pit mining 2014-2023; underground since 2019. Approved until 2032.
mines.processing: 1.1-1.2 Mtpa Tomingley plant (flotation + fine grind circuit, paste plant)

mines.mine_notes: High-grade underground gold-antimony mine in Central Victoria (~50km east of Bendigo), acquired via the Mandalay Resources merger completed 5 August 2025 (after FY2025 year-end), so no FY2025 statutory production or cost figures are reported. AR reports: calendar year 2024 production 43.3 koz Au and 1.3 kt Sb = 54.8 koz AuEq; FY2025 (descriptive): 49.4 koz AuEq. FY2026 guidance: 40-45 koz Au and 800-900t Sb. Significant critical-mineral antimony producer. Processing: 140 ktpa Brunswick plant.

Underground gold mine in northern Sweden (~28km NW of Skellefteå, 750km north of Stockholm), acquired via the Mandalay Resources merger completed 5 August 2025 (after FY2025 year-end); Mandalay acquired it in 2014. No FY2025 statutory production or cost figures in the AR. AR reports production FY2025: 41.4 koz Au (descriptive). Open pit mining 1988-2019 (paused; potential to resume); underground mining since 2008. Processing: 1.4 Mtpa Björkdal plant. FY2026 guidance: 40-44 koz Au. MRE/OR cover Björkdal, Norrberget and Storheden deposits; estimated as at 31 Dec 2024 and depleted to 30 June 2025.

notes: FY2025 annual report (year ended 30 June 2025, published 24 October 2025). Alkane merged with Mandalay Resources Corporation on 5 August 2025, after year-end, becoming a three-mine gold/antimony producer: Tomingley (NSW), Costerfield (Victoria, gold-antimony) and Björkdal (Sweden). Statutory FY2025 production of 70,120 oz is Tomingley only; the AR also discloses Björkdal FY2025 production of 41.4 koz Au and Costerfield FY2025 49.4 koz AuEq on a descriptive basis. FY2026 annual report not yet published as of 25 Sep 2026 (marketindex forecasts ~23 Oct 2026). Preliminary final report (21 Aug 2026) reported record FY2026: revenue A$935.8M, NPAT A$228.7M, record 168,337 AuEq oz produced (164,878 AuEq oz sold), avg realised gold price A$5,664/oz, year-end cash/bullion/investments A$454M, maiden fully franked dividend 2.0 cps. Updated FY2026 resources/reserves statements (11 Sep 2026): Tomingley Ore Reserve +3.2% to 641 koz; Björkdal Ore Reserve +3.7% to 563 koz. Dual-listed ASX:ALK / TSX:ALK, OTCQX:ALKRY. Boda-Kaiser copper-gold project (796 Mt MRE, 8.28 Moz Au + 1.46 Mt Cu) is exploration-stage and not included as a mine. All dollar figures in AUD unless stated.
